groups.title: Fit with your company
groups.blurb: How closely the prospect matches what you sell: industry, technology, pain keywords, vocabulary and the original similarity score.

groups.title: Buying triggers
groups.blurb: Signs that now is a good moment: funding, hiring, new leadership, launches, pain and growth language, one signal per phrase.

groups.title: Size and maturity
groups.blurb: Headcount, offices, countries, age, awards, certifications and how the company talks about its customers.

groups.title: Web presence
groups.blurb: What their site offers: pricing, blog, careers, demo buttons, live chat, API docs, case studies and social profiles.

groups.title: Technology
groups.blurb: The tools they use, from CRM and analytics to payments, cloud and support desks.

groups.title: Needs in their own words
groups.blurb: The problems their text describes: manual work, scaling, cost, speed, compliance, lead generation and more.

groups.title: Industry
groups.blurb: What kind of business they look like, across sixteen sectors.

groups.title: News
groups.blurb: Funding, hiring, launches, partnerships and leadership changes in the headlines, and the tone of the coverage.

groups.title: Reachability
groups.blurb: Whether the right person was found, how senior, and how sure Raptor is about their address.
